account_number.description: Virginia withholding account number: 15 characters starting with 30 (withholding) or 38 (pass-through entity), hyphens removed, e.g. 30 + FEIN + F001

rules: Virginia requires one RS record per employee, with state code 51 in positions 3-4 and 274-275; SSA does not require RS.

Virginia reads the RE record (tax year in positions 3-6, FEIN in 8-16, employer name in 40-96) and, in each RS record, the employee's SSN, name, address, state wages (276-286) and state tax withheld (287-297). Other RS positions are filler to Virginia.

Other EFW2 records may be included in the file; Virginia does not use or validate them. This file is a complete SSA EFW2 file, so it also carries RO and RU records when employees have amounts that go in them.
If an RE record has an error, Virginia does not review its RS records until it is corrected.
Each record except the last is followed by exactly one CR/LF; no delimiter before the first record or inside a record.
Only one form type per file. Virginia recommends naming the file 'W2 REPORT', optionally with the tax year, with no special characters.

RS 248-267 (SSA's State Employer Account Number) is filler in Virginia's W-2 layout; this program puts the Virginia withholding account number from Box 15 there and checks its format, which Virginia's W-2C layout describes as 15 characters beginning with 30 or 38.

source.title: Virginia Tax, Web Upload Guide for W-2s, W-2Cs, and 1099s (Revised 1/2025), Appendix A

ui_quarterly.portal: VEC Web Upload (hosted by Virginia Tax), SUI tax report
ui_quarterly.provisional_note: Matches VEC's own EFW2 sample file record for record, but VEC's sample is a template of zeros and placeholders with no field definitions. The VEC totals record (RT) is VEC-specific; the meaning of its fields is inferred from Form FC-20, and one two-digit field (positions 11-12) is unidentified. Upload a test file through VEC Web Upload and check its Line Counts and Validation Totals before filing.
rules: Record set from VEC's EFW2 sample: RA, RE, one RS per employee, RT, RF. No RW records, so RF counts 0 RW records.

RS (SSA layout): state code 51 at 3-4; SSN, first name (15), middle, last name (20); reporting period 197-202 (last month and year of the quarter, e.g. 032025); total quarterly UI wages 203-213; VEC account number 248-267 as 20 digits, zero-filled (VEC's sample shows 20 zeros; VEC's portal help asks for a 10-digit account number such as 0001234567). VEC's sample has 'B' at 5 and 308 and leaves every other numeric field blank, including per-employee taxable wages (214-224) and all income tax fields; this file does the same.

RT is VEC's own record, not SSA's: from VEC's sample, a 7-digit count at 3-9, an unidentified 2-digit field at 11-12, three 14-digit amounts at 14-27, 29-42 and 44-57 and three 7-digit counts at 59-65, 67-73 and 75-81, each separated by one blank. Form FC-20 asks for exactly three wage totals (total wages, wages above the $8,000 base, wages subject to tax) and three monthly employee counts (0 to 9,999,999, i.e. 7 digits), so this file puts them there in FC-20's order. INFERRED: confirm with VEC.
Records are separated by LF (not CR/LF), with an LF after the last record, as in VEC's EFW2 sample.

VEC's Excel template: SSN 9 digits, not starting 000, 666 or 900-999, no all-zero group; first name up to 15 letters, last name up to 20 letters (letters only: punctuation is removed from names, as in every file this program writes); amounts are positive.
The RA and RE records follow SSA's layout; VEC's sample fills the company, submitter and employer names and addresses, tax year and EINs.

source.title: VEC Web Upload Guide (July 2026); VEC sample files 'sample_EFW2_Quarterly_Wage_Report_VEC.txt' and 'sample_Excel_Quarterly_Wage_Report_VEC.xls' (received by email from VEC, 2026-11-19); SSA Publication 42-007 RS record
